provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Zal’tharuun is centered at -60.995070, -104.773998 under Tribal Confederation, with 81,309,000 people across 14 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Zal’tharuun occupies 10,763,398.02 sq mi / 27,877,072.91 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 5.465387% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Ocean Surface floating settlement and Farming define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Ocean Surface floating settlement, Beach and grass with water, Hybrid tree and forest floor, Underwater without reefs, Partial forest, and 1 more. Population density is 2.917 people/sq km / 7.554 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Elemental and Energy-Born Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Triton, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Hadozee, Merfolk, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Obsidian Diadem, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Enkirael, Freyseth, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Bastveig, Sigrananna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 5 recorded four-province geography group links, including 4 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Cog Vell
npcs.description: Cog Vell is a precise, anxious Monodrone merchant with a clockmaker’s patience, a survivalist’s caution, and the exhausted humor of someone who has spent too long pretending not to care. They keep their shelves neat, their ledgers exact, and their emotions compartmentalized, but their ward-like loyalty to memory-wounded refugees makes it obvious that their detachment is more shield than truth. At the Varesh-Ka Archive, Cog sells armor fittings, repair supplies, salvage adhesives, fog-safe gear, and discreet remedies for ichor sickness while quietly serving as a local expert on strange bodies, altered minds, and the hidden rules of people who live between worlds. They are solitary by habit, helpful under protest, deeply knowledgeable, and unexpectedly fierce when someone threatens a vulnerable person they have decided is under their protection.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Varesh-Ka is a City in Zal’tharuun, under Tribal Confederation, with elevated danger, Partial forest, Beach and grass with water, Farming terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Monodrone does not have a close ancestry entry in the open roster index, so table behavior should follow the local settlement record.
rumors: Cog Vell knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Sigranday.
Cog Vell has a contact in Sylmaris who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Cog Vell asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Cog Vell's public story is incomplete.

npcs.name: Kell Orggan
npcs.description: Kell Orggan is an old Shadowmoor Elf mercenary whose long life has been cut into contracts, funerals, and things he survived by becoming worse than the people hunting him. He works for the Glasswell Institute because they pay, enhance, and point him at targets, but his loyalty is transactional and his conscience is buried rather than gone. Kell is quiet, brutal, and almost bored by violence until a job brushes against the few memories he has not managed to kill.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Varesh-Ka is a City in Zal’tharuun, under Tribal Confederation, with elevated danger, Partial forest, Beach and grass with water, Farming terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Shadowmoor Elf reads through the Half-Elf (choose an Elf Bloodline) entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Half-Elf — Shadowmoor Elf. Half-elves are dual-natured beings born of human and elven lineage, often balancing ambition with longevity. They tend to struggle with identity but excel at diplomacy, adaptability, and bridging cultures. Table cues: +2 Charisma, +1 to Two Other Ability Scores, Darkvision, Fey Ancestry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Neutral.
rumors: Kell's body carries old Directorate grafts that keep him alive but make every decade more expensive.
He never spends blood money in the same province where he earned it.
plotHooks: The party finds Kell's name tied to an old kidnapping, but the surviving witness remembers him sparing someone he was paid to kill.
Kell offers information on the Directorate if the party helps him erase a contract that owns what is left of his future.
